product.title: First Light - 100ml
product.description: First Light captures the essence of dawn with a luminous fragrance journey. Top notes of raspberry, pear, bergamot, and strawberry open with crisp freshness. Base notes of warm amber, sensual musk, and earthy patchouli provide a grounding finish that lingers beautifully. A sophisticated 100ml fragrance for those who embrace elegance from sunrise to dusk.

The heart reveals a delicate floral bouquet of jasmine, white flowers, and tuberose, adding elegance and depth. The base settles into warm, sensual notes of musk, vanilla, and sandalwood, leaving a lasting impression throughout the day.

product.title: Triumph - 100ml
product.description: Triumph captures elegance in a 100ml bottle. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of plum, pineapple, bergamot, and lime, creating a fresh, fruity introduction. The heart reveals a sophisticated floral blend of rose, jasmine, and origanum, adding depth and romance. The base grounds the composition with warm amber, musk, cedarwood, and sandalwood, leaving a lasting, sensual trail. Perfect for those who appreciate a well-balanced fragrance that transitions beautifully from day to evening.

product.title: Maverick - 100ml
product.description: Maverick captures the essence of bold sophistication in a 100ml bottle. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of apple, pepper, and citrus notes, creating an immediate sense of energy and freshness. The heart reveals a warm, woody character through sandalwood, cedarwood, and guaiacwood, grounding the fragrance with elegance and depth. As the scent settles, vanilla and amber notes emerge in the base, delivering a creamy, sophisticated finish that lingers throughout the day.

product.title: True Essence - 100ml
product.description: True Essence captures the perfect balance of nature's most luxurious scents. Open with vibrant top notes of orange, red fruits, and peach, softened by touches of ivy green. The heart blooms with violet, jasmine, lily, and rose—a floral symphony that unfolds gracefully. As the day progresses, base notes of plum, musk, cedarwood, and sandalwood create a warm, lasting finish that lingers on the skin.

product.title: Milestone - 100ml
product.description: Milestone captures a luminous journey through citrus and florals, settling into a warm embrace. Fresh pear and bergamot open with a bright burst of tangerine, while jasmine and orange blossom create an elegant floral heart. Neroli adds a delicate sophistication before amber, musk, vanilla, and benzoin blend into a soft, lingering base. A refined fragrance for those who appreciate complexity and grace in every spritz.

product.title: Aspire - 100ml

The heart unfolds with warm spices—cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger—creating depth and intrigue. A sophisticated base of vetiver and patchouli grounds the composition, delivering lasting elegance. This 100ml bottle captures the essence of refinement for those who appreciate complexity and character in their signature scent.

product.title: Vision - 100ml

As the scent evolves, a luxurious base of vanilla, musk, amber, vetiver, and resin settles into a warm, sensual finish that lingers throughout the day. A 100ml bottle of refined elegance for those who embrace complexity and distinction.

product.title: Explorer
product.description:
Collapsible Sections — Reference Style
Description

Designed for the modern adventurer, Explorer is a refined fragrance that balances freshness, warmth, and earthy sophistication. It opens with bright citrus and crisp fruit, moves into a delicate floral heart, and settles into a rich, long-lasting base. A scent crafted for those who seek new horizons with confidence and style.

Key Highlights
  • Long-lasting Eau de Parfum concentration
  • Perfect for daytime wear, travel, and exploration
  • A dynamic balance of fresh, floral, and woody-earthy accords
  • Crafted for men who embody curiosity, refinement, and adventure
Fragrance Story

Every journey begins with a spark. Explorer captures that moment — the freshness of new beginnings, the calm balance of nature, and the grounding strength of experience. It is more than a scent; it is an expression of wanderlust, sophistication, and resilience.

How to Apply

Spray lightly on pulse points — wrists, neck, and behind the ears — for a long-lasting scent trail.
